QuestInfo.name: [Maple Music Festival] MMF Fireworks Show
QuestInfo.0: Have you heard about the MMF fireworks show? \rThe fireworks show takes place in the campgrounds every Saturday, #btwice#k a day, for all three weeks of the festival! That's on #b10/1, 10/8, and 10/15#k. \r Don't miss a great show and an awesome buff!
